correctness.rationale: For nilpotency index three the nonzero-product structure consists of a universal unary relation and the arc relation. Absence of a directed two-walk gives one explicit three-vertex obstruction and the exact bound b=3; a directed two-walk in a bipartite target admits critical oriented odd-cycle obstructions of arbitrarily large size. The 2026 published nilpotent finite-basis/finite-duality equivalence transfers both branches and its variable-bound theorem gives four variables. Adding a single arc to the five-element example produces a transitive tournament with exact critical obstruction bound b=4. The calculations and associativity claims agree with a separately executed enumerator. No independent review of the published reduction theorem is claimed.

value.rationale: A complete, easily evaluated nilpotent-index-three phase boundary for arbitrary bipartite oriented multiplication-support patterns is motivated by the contemporary finite-basis/finite-duality classification. The result supplies a sharp obstruction-size and four-variable bound, a minimal asymmetric nonfinite-basis example, and a single-product five-element boundary switch showing orientation information matters. The claim is not merely finite enumeration, and no broader algebra classification is implied.
